result.reason: The operative language adds a mutual USD 1,000,000 floor, but does not establish the required mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages or clarify that Customer payment obligations are not damages. The content of “Excluded Claims” is not provided, and the margin comment cannot supply missing operative carve-outs; even the comment identifies only indemnification and confidentiality/data-protection carve-outs, omitting at least gross negligence and wilful misconduct required by the fallback. The cap also uses “all amounts” rather than fees, potentially sweeping in non-fee payments, and measures the period from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself. The drafting otherwise preserves the mutual aggregate-cap structure.
